items: [wave5-carryover WP-93 #1] Two-step sign-in session gates. In server/src/features/auth/routes.ts, before each of the six setSession( calls (password reset, email-verify link, email-verify JSON, OAuth callback redirect, OAuth callback JSON, OAuth complete) call gateSessionForSignIn(loginChallengeDeps(), { userId, brand, sessionToken }) from features/account-v2/index.ts and put the marker comment beside it: // 2fa-gate:password-reset, email-verify-link, email-verify-json, oauth-callback-redirect, oauth-callback-json, oauth-complete. Same inside issueSessionCookie in server/src/features/auth-cn/accounts.ts (// 2fa-gate:issue-session-cookie). On kind:'challenge' answer exactly as POST /login does (no session cookie). In components/auth/methods/EmailMethod.tsx go to /login/2fa?next=… on code two_factor_required. Then set each entry to gated:true in server/src/features/account-v2/readiness.ts. Acceptance: readiness tests green (one marker and one gate call per session call per file); a route test per path shows an enrolled user gets a challenge and no session cookie, an un-enrolled user signs in as before; POST /auth/login and GET /auth/me verified on both brands (legacy response shapes unchanged).

[wave5-carryover WP-93 #2] Bearer JWT cut-off. requireAuth in server/src/middleware/auth.ts rejects a JWT whose iat is before User.tokensValidAfter (null = no cut-off); TwoFactorService.verify() (on enable) and disable() set tokensValidAfter = now. Marker // 2fa-gate:bearer-jwt, then auth.bearerJwt → gated:true in readiness.ts. Acceptance: tests for old-token rejected (401), new token accepted, null column accepted; enrolment opens only when every readiness entry is gated (the status endpoint reports available:true). Mounting <TwoFactorSettings/> in /settings#security is INT-12's item; it hides itself while status is unavailable.

Acceptance: route-level GoApply account-creation tests restored in auth.brand.test.ts and features/auth/legacyAuth.test.ts (no invite → refused, used invite → refused, valid invite + both consents → 201 with consent rows carrying proseHash, missing consent → 422); RoboApply signup unchanged; auth.signupForm.closed no longer shown when signup is open. (ChangePhoneSection mount in #security is INT-12.)

In server/src/features/auth-cn/{phoneAuthService.ts,wechatAuthService.ts,accounts.ts} call growth.recordAttribution(userId, touchWithRef, { signals: { ip, userAgent, deviceId: ra_anon } }) when a phone or WeChat account is created, and checkReferralFor(userId) after phone binding.
